protocol.selection: Hypotheses, views and threshold grids fixed before predictions. No training, prompt iteration or blinded holdout use. Threshold comparisons are development evidence, not independent validation.

scoreProtocol.reason: Initial fixed sweep up to 0.5 showed most KEEP scores above 0.5. Extend score coverage using the same frozen predictions; no model, input, hypothesis, or holdout changes.
scoreProtocol.selection: Report best cache rejection at both 98% and 99% recall, requiring the target on original development, explicitly corrected development, and the deduplicated audited reference. Development-only threshold selection; not calibrated confidence or independent validation.
